name: Monk, level 4 (Way of the Open Hand)

features.name: Unarmored Defense
features.description: While you are wearing no armor and not wielding a shield, your AC equals 10 + your Dexterity modifier + your Wisdom modifier. (Baked into armor_class.)

features.name: Martial Arts
features.description: While unarmed or wielding only monk weapons (shortswords and simple melee weapons without two-handed or heavy) and no armor or shield: you can use Dexterity instead of Strength for unarmed strikes and monk weapons; you can roll a d4 in place of the normal damage of your unarmed strike or monk weapon; and when you use the Attack action with an unarmed strike or a monk weapon, you can make one unarmed strike as a bonus action. (Dexterity and the martial arts die are baked into the unarmed_strike / shortsword actions; the bonus-action strike is the sim's martial_arts convention.)

features.name: Ki
features.description: You have 4 ki points, regained on a short or long rest (resources[] ki). Some ki features require your target to make a saving throw: Ki save DC = 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Wisdom modifier (12).

features.name: Flurry of Blows
features.description: Immediately after you take the Attack action on your turn, you can spend 1 ki point to make two unarmed strikes as a bonus action. (The sim's flurry_of_blows convention, paid from the ki pool.)

features.name: Patient Defense
features.description: You can spend 1 ki point to take the Dodge action as a bonus action on your turn. (Descriptive: no key grants a bonus-action Dodge paid from a pool.)

features.name: Step of the Wind
features.description: You can spend 1 ki point to take the Disengage or Dash action as a bonus action on your turn, and your jump distance is doubled for the turn. (Descriptive: no key grants a bonus-action Dash / Disengage paid from a pool; jumping is not simulated.)

features.name: Unarmored Movement
features.description: Your speed increases by 10 feet while you are not wearing armor or wielding a shield. (Baked into speed.walk 40.)

features.name: Deflect Missiles
features.description: You can use your reaction to deflect or catch the missile when you are hit by a ranged weapon attack. When you do so, the damage you take from the attack is reduced by 1d10 + your Dexterity modifier + your monk level (8). If you reduce the damage to 0, you can catch the missile and spend 1 ki point to make a ranged attack with it. (The reduction is reactions[] deflect_missiles; catching and throwing back the missile is not modelled.)

features.name: Open Hand Technique
features.description: Whenever you hit a creature with one of the attacks granted by your Flurry of Blows, you can impose one of: it must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or be knocked prone; it must make a Strength saving throw or be pushed up to 15 feet away from you; it can't take reactions until the end of your next turn. (Descriptive: no on_event predicate selects the Flurry of Blows strikes.)

features.name: Slow Fall
features.description: You can use your reaction when you fall to reduce any falling damage you take by an amount equal to five times your monk level (20). (Descriptive: falling is not simulated.)
